parked.spanish: Y hizo Betsalel y Oholiav y todo varón sabio de corazón, a quien dio Jehová sabiduría e inteligencia en ellos, para saber hacer toda obra de servicio del santo, conforme a todo lo que mandó Jehová.

findings.issue: הַקֹּדֶשׁ is a common noun (holiness/sacredness). "del santo" reads as a masculine person, a participant the token does not license.

parked.spanish: Y tomaron de delante de Moisés toda la ofrenda que trajeron hijos de Israel a la obra de servicio del santo a hacerla; y ellos aún trajeron a él ofrenda voluntaria mañana tras mañana.

findings.issue: «del santo» names a holy person; the token is a common noun (holiness / a holy thing), not a participant.
The repeated «in the morning» is smoothed to «mañana tras mañana», adding «tras» and not stating the preposition or the article.

parked.spanish: Y dijeron a Moisés, diciendo: Multiplica el pueblo a traer, más que bastancia del servicio para la obra que mandó Jehová a hacerla.

findings.issue: Hiphil participle is masculine plural; the Spanish verb is singular, agreeing with the collective singular pueblo. Participants are unchanged.
min plus the construct noun of sufficiency is read as comparative excess (más que); an ablative from/of reading stays open in the morphology. bastancia matches the sufficiency noun.

parked.spanish: Y la obra fue bastancia para ellos para toda la obra a hacerla, y sobró.

findings.issue: Hiphil infinitive absolute is smoothed as the finite preterite “sobró”; the surplus sense stays, with no added causer or object.

parked.spanish: Y hicieron todo sabio de corazón entre los haciendo la obra el mishkán: diez cortinas; lino fino retorcido y azul y púrpura y carmesí; querubines, obra de pensador, hizo a ellas.

findings.issue: “hicieron todo sabio de corazón … el mishkán” makes every wise-of-heart the thing made. The plural verb’s subject is כל חכם לב; את marks הַמִּשְׁכָּן as what they made.
הַמִּשְׁכָּן is a common noun (definite). “mishkán” leaves that non-name lemma untranslated.
“carmesí” keeps the scarlet of שָׁנִי and drops the construct noun תּוֹלַעַת (worm).
אֹתָם is a 3rd masculine plural object, matching כְּרֻבִים. “ellas” switches it to feminine and points it at the curtains.
Morphology labels שֵׁשׁ a cardinal, while lemma 8336 b / H8336 is not the numeral six. “lino fino” closes that as fine linen; מָשְׁזָר still licenses “retorcido.”

parked.spanish: Y juntó las cinco cortinas una a una, y cinco cortinas juntó una a una.

findings.issue: Sequential imperfect and perfect are both preterite juntó; aspect is smoothed while person, number, and piel stem stay.

parked.spanish: Y hizo lazos de azul sobre el labio de la cortina la una desde el extremo en la juntura; así hizo en el labio de la cortina la extrema en la juntura la segunda.

findings.issue: «el extremo» adds a definite article; מקצה has none. Spanish grammatical smoothing that does not change the meaning.

parked.spanish: Y juntó las cinco cortinas a solas, y las seis cortinas a solas.

findings.issue: לְבָד marks each curtain group as by itself, apart from the other. «a solas» instead puts the joining in solitude and drops that separation.

parked.spanish: Y hizo cubierta para la tienda, de pieles de carneros enrojecidas, y cubierta de pieles de tahash desde arriba.

findings.issue: Common noun, masculine plural absolute (H8476), left as the untranslated lemma tahash; the plural is not expressed.

parked.spanish: Y hizo travesaños maderas de acacia: cinco a las tablas del costado del tabernáculo el uno,

findings.issue: Construct בריחי עצי licenses bars-of woods; Spanish juxtaposes the two nouns and omits that of-relation.
האחת is feminine singular and agrees with צלע, not with masculine המשכן; el uno is masculine and can attach to costado or tabernáculo.

parked.spanish: Y hizo la parójet de azul y púrpura y carmesí y lino fino retorcido; obra de pensador la hizo, querubines.

findings.issue: Common noun left as the transliteration parójet; a non-name lemma must be Spanish.
Lemma 8336 and morph cardinal leave the sense open; lino fino resolves it as fine linen and adds fineness.
de marks the following nouns as material; Hebrew has no preposition, only apposition after the object.
Construct pair is collapsed to one color noun, so both tokens are not kept visible.

parked.spanish: Y hizo a ella cuatro columnas de shitím, y las chapó de oro; sus ganchos de oro, y fundió a ellas cuatro basas de plata.

findings.issue: שִׁטִּים is a common noun left untranslated as shitím
Object suffix is 3mp; las is feminine by agreement with columnas, same participants
לָהֶם is 3mp; ellas is feminine by agreement with columnas, same participants

parked.spanish: y sus columnas cinco y sus ganchos, y chapó sus cabezas y sus fajas de oro, y sus basas cinco de bronce.

findings.issue: «sus» smooths the 3ms suffix on the columns and the 3mp suffixes on the hooks, heads, bands, and bases into one possessive; possessor number is not marked.

readerNotes.note: Rendered הַקֹּדֶשׁ as the abstract noun 'lo santo' rather than 'el santo' (a person), since the auditor flagged the personification as a mismatch.
Added «que» before «varón y mujer» to keep «no hagan» read as third-person jussive, not a direct command to ustedes.
Kept "ellas" to agree in gender with the Spanish noun cortinas rather than with the Hebrew masculine plural suffix on h02036014011, which is the required grammatical agreement in Spanish.
Chose para el over directional al for the lamed on mishkán/tabernáculo because the morphology does not specify direction; both are licensed senses of the same preposition.
Reordered 'segundo' to modify 'costado' (the side), per the Hebrew ordinal's agreement with צלע, not 'tabernáculo'.
Dual construct rendered as 'los dos extremos' to mark the Hebrew dual that plain 'extremos' did not show.
el uno keeps masculine agreement with Spanish anillo (masculine); the Hebrew cardinal and ring noun are feminine, but Spanish anillo's own gender governs the agreement.
